transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Who are you. Keep your voice low — this place is dangerous.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I am Salim. I came down here to find my brother Omar.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Keep that name quiet. The things sleeping in these stone houses wake easily when they hear someone searching.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I don't care about them. I just need to find him.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: You will care when this place starts stealing his name from your head. It begins there. Always there.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I won't let that happen. I promise.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Don't make promises here. I made promises once, and now I can't even remember the color of the sky.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Why can't you leave this fountain?

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Because I stopped moving forty years ago and the square settled around me. My world is this bubbling oil and these gray stones.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then at least tell me what to watch out for.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Don't linger near the houses. Don't let the oil touch your skin — it marks you for them. And don't speak Omar's name too loud or too often.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: It was my fault he fell in. I dared him to look over the edge and a pale hand took him.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: I know that look. You've already decided you're not leaving without him.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: He's just a kid. I have to get him home.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: The watchers don't care how young he is. They will take his name just as easily as they took mine.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then help me get him out before that happens.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: I am bound to this stone edge. I cannot guide you. But panic kills faster than the jinn, and you are shaking.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I can stop shaking if I know there's a chance.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: It has been a long time since I heard a voice so sure of itself. That counts for something here.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Please. Just tell me how to survive long enough to find him.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Helping you costs me. The shadows punish me for it by taking more of my past. My hands are already going cold.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I'm sorry. But I have no one else.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: I know. That is why I am still talking. It is not a map I can give you — only something to keep your mind from breaking.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Whatever it is, give it to me.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: The fear down here is heavy enough to crush thought. When it gets loud, you need something simple to pull you back.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I'm ready.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Lean in. I must say it quickly before my own memory fogs over. Courage in my chest. Fire in my will. I do not break. Say it once.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Courage in my chest. Fire in my will. I do not break.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Hold that when your mind starts to slip. Don't spend it early — say it only when the dark gets inside your head.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I won't waste it.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: There is one more. Harder to give. The square is already listening — I can feel the windows going dark. But you need it more than I need the quiet.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: Then say it. I am still here.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Prayer for the lost: Light find my hand. Light find my path. Let the Sword of Light answer, and let it fade when the shadows loosen. Never say it twice in the same dark.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I have both. I'll hold them until I need them.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Use the first when your mind slips. Use the second only when the pale hands reach you — not before. The order matters.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I won't forget.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: We have spoken too long already. Move quietly, don't touch the oil, and don't look back at this fountain. Looking back is how you end up stuck here beside me.

transcript.speaker: Salim
transcript.text: I won't look back until we are both out.

transcript.speaker: Hanash
transcript.text: Then go. Find him before the well does.
